details: The United States is reportedly preparing for the possibility of resuming military operations against Iran, with the Pentagon ordering preparations for potential strikes on Iranian missile, drone, and energy sites. This follows Iran's leaders admitting a crippling US blockade and threatening retaliation for military action. The ongoing conflict has significantly impacted global oil prices and is a major source of volatility in financial markets.
title: US Prepares for Renewed Iran Conflict, Escalating Middle East Tensions

details: U.S. President Donald Trump announced an "immediate energy ceasefire" in the conflict between Russia and Ukraine, stating both parties agreed to halt attacks on energy infrastructure. However, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy indicated that the announcement was "news" to him, emphasizing that Ukraine would only agree to such a ceasefire if Russia reciprocated by ceasing strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure. The announcement follows a deal for Russia to supply diesel to the US.
title: Trump Claims Russia-Ukraine Energy Ceasefire, Ukraine Seeks Reciprocal Truce

details: Germany's federal cabinet is scheduled to adopt a crypto tax bill on October 14, 2026. The proposed legislation mandates selling platforms to withhold ten times the tax owed from sellers if they lack purchase data. It also abolishes the one-year tax-free holding period for crypto assets acquired after December 31, 2026, introducing a 25% capital gains tax. Withholding tax on investment income is slated to begin in 2028.
title: German Cabinet to Adopt Crypto Tax Bill with 10x Withholding Penalty

details: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics is set to release the Consumer Price Index (CPI) report for September 2026 on Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time. This key economic indicator will provide insights into inflation and is closely watched by financial markets and the Federal Reserve, potentially influencing future interest rate decisions and causing volatility across financial assets, including cryptocurrencies.
title: US September CPI Report Due October 14, Set to Influence Fed Policy
